name: hologram
//peer: Whichever app draws the hologram brings its own copy of these; both of them already depend on all four directly. Skia is only a type import in the main entry, but the react entry calls into it.
//exports: Two entries, and the split matters: '.' is the design and the voice tracking, with nothing but type imports in it, so it runs headless in the tests and under CanvasKit in a browser. './react' is the view, which needs React, Reanimated and Skia for real. The third is for the browser build's lazy import() only — CanvasKit has to finish loading before anything Skia-backed is even imported.
